songs.english_title: He who labours for the village, di

lines.english: He who labours for the village, di,
Knows not a single wrong, di,
Gets kicked and dies, di — buffalo calf.
There is no time for what is good,
Everything that happens is outward show,
Say it plainly — it is a shame — buffalo calf.
The fellow who lives by cheating,
In a seven-storey mansion,
Beats out his swagger there;
But the man who contradicts his word,
Is out begging — buffalo calf.
He talks till we believe him to be the leader of the land,
Then scoops away all the wealth he wants, di;
With the land's prosperity in mind, the poor man labours all day,
For the poor, no good times; all sorts of fellows are thriving —
Buffalo calf.

songs.english_title: The lamp that lights our household life

lines.english: The lamp that lights our household life,
Is the form of my queen of the heart.
The flame that shines within this lamp,
Is the form of my brave one.
The form of a young peacock.
The lamp that lights our household life,
Is the lamp of our love.
O fruit! O sugarcane-Tamil! O nectar!
O flower where dew sleeps! O moon!
With your tender speech, you have captivated me alone —
O magnetic statue!
When I see you, the feeling that seeps through my heart —
For those who would write that very feeling,
There are no letters at all.
Every day like this festival day, dancing and singing,
Let us live like honey.
(Il — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: You are the flower-garland...

lines.english: You are the flower-garland...
Wasted upon dust and earth,
I came — did you crawl?
(Flower-garland — refrain cue)
Will you not look, my rosewater treasure?
We lived in splendour,
We fell with the very roots,
Even the life we lived like a kingdom has fallen,
In this ruined womb of mine you were born, my king!
Why were you born?
(Flower-garland — refrain cue)
Had you been born in a bird's home,
Food, just to end your hunger,
Would have come flying to you;
Crores upon crores of poor people wither,
You were born, my king, in a land where the grandees live!
Why were you born?
(Flower-garland — refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Mari Mahamayi, Mari Mahamayi

lines.english: Mari Mahamayi, Mari Mahamayi,
Aayi, our Kaliamma,
Mari Mahamayi, Mari Mahamayi,
For all of us poor folk to live,
Let the month's mummari rains pour, Mother..
(By the sun, even the sea-water — into cloud itself,
Having changed, upon the world,
Will the rain then fall?
I'll tell you — listen,
See, science is changing anew,
They say by Kodumpavi's grace it will rain hard,
If the sky dries up, all of us will wither,
Thallale la.... ....

lines.source_tamil: திரி சூலி நீலி எங்கள் மாரி மகமாயி
lines.english: Trisuli, Neeli, our Mari Mahamayi,
Unable to pay the tax,
We are withering, Mother...
Omkara-rupini, Mari Mahamayi,

lines.source_tamil: எங்கள் குறை தீர்த்து விடு மாரி மகமாயி
lines.english: Set right our grievance, Mari Mahamayi.
(Mari — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: O speaking yaazh, O doe

lines.english: O speaking yaazh, O doe,
You are the breeze that blows.
O blue sky, forgetting yourself,
Can you go praising the moon?
O beauty! O Tamil epic,
O painting never painted —
Speaking and speaking words of delight,
Casting and casting loving glances.
O speaking yaazh, O doe —
If I am the yaazh, you are its resonance, are you not?
In resonance there can be difference;
Let there be none of that between us.
Long live love, O fruit-nectar,
Delight of women and warriors.

songs.english_title: I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!

lines.english: I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!
Knowing not even the life of womanhood,
I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!
The veena is broken — what music is there now?
Here the thunderbolt has fallen; the flower-garden is destroyed,
I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!
Having blown poison into my life and vanished,
I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!
I became a vine that withers,
In the cyclone wind,
Stain soaked and closed over the pollen-bearing petal,
I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!
I see no flame of joy,
I am alone in a house of darkness,
Struck by the wave of a storm of sorrow,
In the grove of a sorrowful life,
I am a flower without fragrance — without marriage — amma!

songs.english_title: O speaking yaazh, O doe — lament

lines.english: O speaking yaazh, O doe,
You are the breeze that blows,
Will I ever again hear a song like this...
(Pesum — source refrain cue)
In an unbearable whirl of fire,
Did you fall alone?
I became a yaazh that plucks an unreturning sorrow,
By undying love we lived — love...
(Pesum — source refrain cue)
Will you wander the earth as a singing ghost?
I became a page on which endless sorrow was inscribed,
Did you forget the affection that never changes — love?
(Pesum — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Come, come... Vaibhoga Sundariye...

lines.english: Aaha, aaha!
Come, come...
Vaibhoga Sundariye...
Saibhoga Soundariye!
Sairandhri... dear one... come...

lines.source_tamil: கீசகன் ஆசை கொண்ட கிச்சிலிப் பழமடி நீ...
lines.english: You are the kichili fruit that Kichaka desired, di...

lines.source_tamil: காச நோய்போல வந்த காதலுக்கு மருந்தடி நீ...
lines.english: You are the medicine, di, for love that came like consumption...
O handsome one, Mammudha, desire-struck Kichaka!
Kichaka! Kichaka!
Kichaka!... Dei...
You came in madness, twirling your moustache,
You monkey! You great big monkey!
Making all eight directions tremble,
Before Bhimasena, whose drum thunders,
You wag your tail...?
You wag your tail...?

songs.english_title: Let us lay out a new path

lines.english: Let us lay out a new path — we — the evil,
Path that leads to fighting, we shall bring it down...
By labouring every day, we shall rise —
Without straying from the path, we shall live —
The barren waste of ignorance — with the plough-point,
That is good knowledge...
The barren waste of ignorance — with the plough-point,
That is good knowledge...
With the plough-point that is knowledge...
With the great knowledge of science — ploughing,
We are those who seek true wisdom!
With the great knowledge of science — ploughing,
We are those who seek true wisdom!
We shall live rising upward — with the times,
We shall change along with change,
We shall change along with change.
With knowledge springing forth — with new,
Tools we shall take command — we,
With knowledge springing forth — with new,
Tools we shall take command — we!
We'll plant the seedlings — the weeds,
We'll yank up and throw away!
We'll plant the seedlings — the weeds,
We'll yank up and throw away!
We'll guard and grow them — the grain-head,
Seeing it, we'll rejoice — the grain-head,
Seeing it, we'll rejoice...
By the grace of the god who came in a dream,
They say Nandanar raised the crop...
As always, with the help of our hands and legs,
We raised the crop this day...
In the bending ear of grain you ripened and came, O golden queen...

lines.source_tamil: வாழ்வில் இன்பம் பொங்கிட வந்தாய் எங்கள் தோழியே...
lines.english: You came, our comrade, so joy may overflow in life...
“We have found a common granary,
We have laid out a new path” ...

songs.english_title: Long live, long live, long live, long live!

lines.english: Long live, long live, long live, long live!
Our precious Arignar,
Long live Anna!
Long live Kumara Anna!
Against all those men who boast of greatness,
Who, whatever the matter, like buffaloes,
Go on nodding their heads — for rights,
He stands opposing them,
Long live Anna!
Long live our Anna!
The poor man writhing like a worm,
The grandee flying like an eagle — these,
All these wicked divisions,
He made into a golden land where they are no more — that,
Anna, long live!
Kumara Anna, long live!
The widow living like a mouse,
Youth being given as sacrifice,
Old custom pouncing like a tiger,
This cruelty that has become so commonplace,
Long live Anna who will change it!
Long live Kumara Anna.
Here and there, Panathottam — that,
Selvak Kumari... Kottam! Like this,
A honey-stream speaking many, many ideas,
An ideal history that feeds rational thought —
Long live Anna!
Long live Kumara Anna.

songs.english_title: We need a heart that can bear anything

lines.english: We need a heart that can bear anything,
In this world, enmity and blame strike like snakes —
We need a heart that can bear anything,
Prison? Torture? What more...
(Ethaiyum — source refrain cue)
Look at the life of Socrates,
Look also at the end of deathless Gandhi,
Do not fall because of pain,
Do not wither under trial — you, do not wither,
Do not wither under trial — what comes...
(Ethaiyum — source refrain cue)
Life called honey itself will turn into a scorpion,
In public life, death at the battlefront is joy,
Arrogance may roar, the army may pounce,
Seeing fury, do not scatter — let the heart not scatter,
Hearing slander, do not wilt — enmity...
(Ethaiyum — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Ammaiyappa, grant your grace — all is your doing

lines.english: Ammaiyappa, grant your grace — all is your doing,
Ammaiyappa,
All is your doing, Ammaiyappa.
Ammaiyappa, grant your grace — all is your doing,
Ammaiyappa,
All is your doing, Ammaiyappa.
This life, the afterlife; pleasure, pain,
Truth, falsehood, the bonds of the world —
All is your doing, Ammaiyappa.
Poison in honey, clear nectar, honey-cascade, fire-forest,
Burning pool, volcanoes — all are your doing, Ammaiyappa;

lines.source_tamil: அரசன் முதல் ஆண்டிகளும் ஐயன் சிருஷ்டி உண்மையப்பா
lines.english: From the king down to aandis, all are Aiyan's creation — true, appa,
This is Aiyan's creation — true, appa.

lines.source_tamil: பல்லக்கு தூக்கிகளும் அதில் பவனி வருகின்ற மனிதர்களும்
lines.english: The palanquin-bearers, and the people who ride in procession within it,
Ammaiyappa — within your
Bounds they live; that is true, appa,
The toad within the stone, the oil within sesame,
The cruel venom within the snake's fang —
Ammaiyappa, this ancient world says
That all of it is your doing, appa.

songs.english_title: Look at the blue sea, paappa...

lines.english: Look at the blue sea, paappa...
Swim and play in it, paappa...
On the bed of silver sand, paappa,
Leap and play, paappa...
Run and play, paappa... you,
Stroll at ease, paappa...
Sway, little one, sway,
O sandalwood parrot, sway,
O beautiful peacock, sway,
O nectar-dove, sway.
(Saa — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: O realm of love, O new dream

lines.english: O realm of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart, come running.
(Kaa — source refrain cue)
When I see the great cloud roaming the sky,
The grove's plumage dances...
(Kaa — source refrain cue)
O great gem born of love...
You are the treasure of a blissful life.
O maiden who stands dancing in my eyes.
Let us behold the boundary of bliss...
O veena of my heart....
This is a life without equal.
O moon of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart — come running.

songs.tamil_title: காதல் துறையே புதுமைக் கனவே — சோக கீதம்
songs.english_title: O realm of love, O new dream — song of sorrow

lines.english: O realm of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart, come running.
(Kaa — source refrain cue)
When I see the great cloud roaming the sky...
The grove's plumage dances...
(Kaa — source refrain cue)
O great gem born of love...
You are the treasure of a blissful life,
O song that drifts upon the breeze,
O honey-rain, my life,
To behold the boundary of bliss,
In sorrow, let us sleep in the lap.

songs.english_title: O little new flower

lines.english: O little new flower,
O lovely agal-lamp...
O unique taste of sugarcane,
O rock-candy, O fruit-nectar...
(Sin — source refrain cue)
O jewel-like ear of red paddy,
O sweet-tasting red sugarcane...
O treasure-house gathered as
A flower of refined Tamil...
(Sin — source refrain cue)
O southern grace of the Kaveri,
O casket of the learned...
In the grove spread open with flowers,
O new fragrance that overflows...
(Sin — source refrain cue)
You... gave that state — `at night, darkness gathers` —
That very condition,
O golden beauty of Dravida...
Live on, O nectar of heaven —
(Sin — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Shattered is my love's living portrait

lines.english: Shattered is my love's living portrait,
Destroyed is the epic of flavour in my life.
Shattered is my love's living portrait,
Destroyed is the epic of flavour in my life.
The heart-enchanting life, the flame of life, slips away hidden...
A storm blows... in the flower-garden...
(Mana — source refrain cue)
The divine statue of love where grace dwells has fallen...
My life has become an empty temple,
Gone to waste...
(Mana — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Why does the love-dove speak into the ear?

lines.english: Why does the love-dove speak into the ear? —
What secret might it hold...
Was the affection I bore all in vain?...
Why was I born a maiden?...
The young queen with a tender-shoot body has withered,
O leaping breeze, come... come...
To end this sorrow... you... come...
In a forest where a deer-skinned tiger lives,
Can the mango-cuckoo truly sing?...
Was the affection I bore all in vain?...
Why was I born a maiden?...
The queen has fallen into darkness where sorrow dwells,
O sleeping moon-maiden — come
To scatter light, dear one...
Through love itself I was deceived,
Will none of my dreams of desire come true?
Was the affection I bore all in vain?
Why was I born a maiden?...
(Kaa — source refrain cue)

songs.english_title: Come... come... come...

lines.english: Come... come... come...
Everyone, come here,
Buy a ticket... come...
Tonight is a very fine night,
A night of pleasure without equal...
One floor ticket!
Half a rupee!
Give it, give it — here!

lines.source_tamil: தரை அரை ரூபா!-கரை படிந்த தரை அரை ரூபா
lines.english: Floor, half a rupee! — the stained floor, half a rupee,

lines.source_tamil: ரத்த கறை படிந்த தரை அரை ரூபா
lines.english: The blood-stained floor, half a rupee,

lines.source_tamil: வெற்றிலை பாக்கு கறை படிந்த தரை அரை ரூபா
lines.english: The betel-leaf-and-areca-stained floor, half a rupee,
(Tonight)
(Tonight)
Hey, ma, what drama is it today?
Hey Venkatrama, stand in the company!
How do you know my name?
Have you learnt sleight-of-hand magic?
Floor, half a rupee... bench, one,
Back bench, three!..
Hey... kaali...
Kaali! kaali!...
Naarkaali... five rupees...
Quote me a little less in rupees.
Quote a little less, ma... Kokila Vani,
Amma, Kokila Vani,
Amma, Kokila Vani.
You cheat, get lost... hey, fellow... fool...
Don't die for nothing, da...
Ah!
To hear these lines in our drama,
A few rupees? Five rupees, that's all,
A beautiful drama, lovely scenes,
Speeches that throw fire —

lines.source_tamil: ஆடல்... பாடல் ஊடல்... கூடல் எல்லாம் காண
lines.english: To see dance... song... sulking... reunion — all of it,
Come here... come,
Buy a ticket, come, come.
Above three years of age, full charge,
Change your seat and it's double charge,
In the dressing scene, don't shine a torch,
(Three)
For fifty-three?
Easy chair!...
Hey, ma! Is there a separate place for women?
There is even me, who has borne children!
Beeda, cigarette, areca nut, betel leaf,
Soda, colour, orange!
Beer-aa?
Hey, bureau!
Bureau — table-na, table-na!
Muttanna, daavanna, ullanna — go, ya!
(Three)
Hey, ma, is there a half ticket?
Ayya... there isn't even a full ticket for you!
Why so?
House full!

songs.english_title: The trouble of having no work

lines.english: The trouble of having no work,
Has gone away like morning dew...
A good life I had never imagined,
Came and joined me of its own accord,
This is a fine day of joy,
This is a golden day of wealth...
Ah, happiness — happiness itself...
Those I had never known before came as kin, just as my heart wished,
I have found well-being,
As forms of love,
So that my sorrow may leave me,
They came today to bring me good,
Thinking me a seemaatti, they were deceived,
Ah, what a wonder this is...

songs.english_title: Saying the ocean-girdled world had dawned

lines.english: Saying the ocean-girdled world had dawned,
You woke my life-beloved bridegroom,
Crowed like a rooster and even my chastity,
You pecked away, cruel woman! Great sinner!
You came here like the end-age and played havoc; broken,
I have become like a shattered thaazhi-vessel — now,
Will this life remain even one moment?
Will it state the grammar of chastity... will it...
Will my life remain...?

songs.english_title: Jewel-dove!... new jewel-dove!...

lines.english: Jewel-dove!...
New jewel-dove!... brand-new,
New jewel-dove!... it is I,
Through the love that dwells,
My heart leaps toward you,
The bed spreads flowers and calls,
Poomaane, come a little closer,
A rose enclosure, a jasmine garden,
That is my very face,
Raja, for you I alone am the queen,
I shall give you pleasure indeed.

songs.english_title: O girl born to a blind father!

lines.english: Veena!...
Vaali!...
That is fake!...
O girl born to a blind father!

lines.source_tamil: எண்ணற்ற பொய் சொல்லி என்னையே மாற்றிய என் தங்கமே!
lines.english: My gold, who told countless lies and changed even me!
If a cat closes its eyes, will the whole world turn dark,
Will it? Meow, meow,

lines.source_tamil: வானை நோக்கித் திரையைப் போட்டால் வட்ட நிலவும்
lines.english: If a curtain is drawn facing the sky, will the round moon,
Disappear?
(Kan)

lines.source_tamil: கெட்டிக்காரன் பொய்யும் புரட்டும் எட்டு நாளைக்கு - இந்தக்
lines.english: A clever man's lies and twists last eight days — but this,

lines.source_tamil: கட்டிக் கரும்பின் பொய்யும் புரட்டும் எத்தனை நாளைக்கு? ஆ!
lines.english: Bundled sugarcane's lies and twists — how many days will they last? Ah!
(Kan)
I didn't tell any lies at all,
It is all true...
O girl from the house next door to Harishchandra!
In speaking truth so unjustly, who,
On this earth can equal you, dear!
Rani: Raja!
Raja: Rani!
Rani: Ah!... (astonishment)
Like the queen in a deck of cards,
You've been caught, peahen,
We can live without distress,
Flower-cuckoo!

lines.source_tamil: கிளாவர் ராணி! உனக்கு என்ன வேணுமின்னு கேளு!...
lines.english: Clavar Queen! Ask what you want!...
Dance like the queen of dance,
Sing like the Daiman Queen,
Hey, Ispade Queen!
Why this sorrow?
What anger have you against me?
Is it the sin of telling the truth?
What yearning is in your heart?

songs.english_title: Public welfare — always public welfare

lines.english: Public welfare — always public welfare,
A most sacred act that guards the body of fame,
Public welfare — always public welfare,

lines.source_tamil: வீடுவாசல் மாடு மனை மக்கள் சுற்றம் போலாலும்
lines.english: House, threshold, cattle, home, people and kin though there may be,
Country — our country, good country — saying 'country',
It is the sacrifice we all make together,
(Public welfare)
Fit for nothing in the country,
Doing no work at all in the house — into the body,
As into a cage, stuffing food and living,

lines.source_tamil: உருப்படா மனிதனுக்குயிர் கொடுக்கும் மருந்து - நல்ல மருந்து
lines.english: A medicine that gives life to the useless man — a good medicine.
The pandaaram who sleeps on the front veranda,
The paradesi bearing the sacred begging bowl,
The Tirupati Govinda rolling in the street — Govinda, Govinda,
A medicine that gives life to this lazy walking corpse,
(Public welfare)
The lines that fall upon the forehead,
The lines of old age,
The evils that grow in the mind,

lines.source_tamil: கச்சிதமாய் அகற்றிவிடும் கைகண்ட மருந்து - நல்ல மருந்து
lines.english: A proven medicine that removes them precisely — a good medicine,
Worship at the temple of knowledge,
The culture of the working comrade,
Let us live, let us live, with love along the path of virtue,
A medicine that gives light to these higher duties,
(Public welfare)

songs.english_title: Ayarpadi Kanna, you

lines.english: Ayarpadi Kanna, you,

lines.source_tamil: ஆடவாராய் என்னோடு - மாயக்காரா வா வா வா - ஜாலக்காரா
lines.english: Come dance with me — Mayakkara, come, come, come — Jaalakkara,
Ohoho — hey Bhagavane — Bhagavane, Bhagavane,
I am a queen beautiful like Bhama,
Love I cannot bear blows like burning embers,
Look at this gold that cannot be found,
Look at this body that sprinkles love,
Mayakkara — Jaalakkara — hey Bhagavane, Bhagavane — (Bhagavane),
The lightning that races with the sky has become my waist,
My honey-seeping cheek is a divine drink,
Look at these eyes that put the spear to shame,
Look at this speech that enchants a person,
Mayakkara — Jaalakkara — hey Bhagavane, Bhagavane — (Bhagavane).

songs.english_title: In the sky-flower grove

lines.english: In the sky-flower grove,
To behold the honeyed moon,
It runs in the breeze,
O jasmine creeper dancing in the wind,
In our life joined by companionship,
Let us behold bliss today,
O lord of desire, beautiful queen,
She surges in waves with love that overflows the dam,
Come near,
The fire too is quenched; the breeze blows,
As nectar that never cloys, as sweet mango-fruit,
I have found a new life.

songs.english_title: One day by the stream

lines.english: One day by the stream, my,
lips he plucked and kissed,
What can I say of that pleasure-bliss?
In the chill of the north wind, the dear one embraced this body,
Saying, ‘I will come,’ he went away, di, my friend,
I sat down for the eduppu — and in my,
thoughts he came and mingled,
I took up the yaazh to make pann-music,
Before my eyes he stood,
I sprang forward to embrace him,
Like lightning, he vanished.

songs.english_title: O Tamil, O honey, dear one — thaalelo

lines.english: O Tamil, O honey, dear one — thaalelo,

lines.source_tamil: தங்க ஜோதி வீசும் தீபமே தாலேல தாலல தாலேலோ
lines.english: O lamp that casts golden radiance — thaalela, thaalala, thaalelo,
Like a sea where waves collide,
is the heart of the mother who bore you,
When its state keeps changing,
you alone came as the moon,
Like a peacock that beholds a cloud,
on beholding your lovely face,
my sorrow will leave and I too shall dance,
Sleepless dear one, sleep, pa.

songs.english_title: There are waves in the sea

lines.english: There are waves in the sea,
There is movement in the body,
There is art in the bend,
Is there a price in this world — for me,
Is there a price in this world?
(Wave)
There is a net in the eyes — a fruit-
cluster is there in the speech,
There is a statue before me,
Is there a price in this world — for me,
Is there a price in this world?
(Wave)
In the coquettish walk, in the gleaming waist,
In throbbing youth, in the arrow it strings,
As sweetness glides through a shining life,
We are poems of pleasure being recited!
(Wave)

songs.english_title: We can walk on water

lines.english: We can walk on water,
We can lie down in fire,
If our state staggers, we can say whatever we think.
Why does the world spin? Our,
body spins — that's why,
Why does the world spin?
Our body spins — that's why.
Why does kalagam — commotion — come?
Because the kalayam pot bubbles over,
Why does kalagam — commotion — come?
Because the kalayam pot bubbles over,
Why does heaven appear?
Because dizziness comes,
Why does heaven appear?
Because dizziness comes.
(World)
Why does it captivate the eye? — this,
maiden-girl, that's why,
Why does it captivate the eye?
This maiden-girl, that's why.
Maiden-girl.... mm..... mm......,
one on the cheek.
Why does the world spin?
Our body spins — that's why.
(World)

songs.tamil_title: வெல்க நாடு வெல்க நாடு வெல்க வெல்கவே
songs.english_title: May the land triumph, may the land triumph — triumph, triumph!

lines.source_tamil: வெல்க நாடு வெல்க நாடு வெல்க வெல்கவே
lines.english: May the land triumph, may the land triumph — triumph, triumph!

lines.source_tamil: வீர சங்க நாதம் கேட்டு செல்க செல்கவே
lines.english: Hear the warrior-conch blast and go, go!
Let the armies go — let the armies go...
(May the land triumph)

lines.source_tamil: தாயின் ஆணை கேட்பதற்கு தலை வணங்கும் தங்கமே
lines.english: Golden one who bows the head to heed the mother's command,
Give your head and guard the mother's honour, O lion,
Go and return — win and return...
(May the land triumph)
Speaking baby-talk like kumalai,
the kisses of the children,
and the lovely-voiced sound
of coaxing Anjugam,

lines.source_tamil: உன் குன்று தோளில் புது பலத்தை வழங்குமடா நித்தமும் சென்று வா -
lines.english: will give new strength every day to your hill-like shoulder, da — go and return —
win and return...
(May the land triumph)

lines.source_tamil: மகிமை கொண்ட மண்ணின் மீது எதிரிகளின் கால்கள்
lines.english: Upon the glorious soil — the feet of enemies,
the feet of enemies,
Warriors' hands do not pluck flowers, da,
the hands of great warriors,
Go and return — win and return...
(May the land triumph)
His form is like an upraised sword, da — his,
radiant eyes are the mould of the world, da,
He is the vengai-tiger king, da,
the leader of warriors, da — await his,
command, good one,
Set out toward the battlefield, mighty one..
(May the land triumph)

songs.english_title: ‘One woman for one man’

lines.english: Holding within it the life-breath,
‘one woman for one man,’
‘Domestic life is what is called virtue; even that,
is good if it brings no blame from another’ — says the,
Thirukkural; do not forget it,
do not stray from your direction,
The boat called life,
the lesson it gives,
within the human heart,
is a Veda impossible to forget,
(Life)
Youth is a costume that fades — in it,
the one who says ‘let whatever comes, come’ is a complete fool,
the one who guards before it comes is the wise one — before the storm,
the one who guards before it comes is the wise one,
the one who suffers after it comes is the dupe,
(Life)
A boat without oars — the waves,
will take it in every direction they call — a life with no one,
to block evil — that life too,
will become like the state of that boat.

songs.english_title: Cheek, cheek, cheek

lines.english: Cheek, cheek, cheek — sandalwood
Bowl, bowl, bowl — my
Colour, colour, colour — love's
Sign, sign, sign,
(Cheek)
I shall serve a feast of youth — drink it,
A thousand adventures are in my hands,
The bird comes forcefully,
It is going to grow the bond,
The moon burns like fire,
You too will embrace and hold me,
(Cheek)
Dizziness in the gaze — enchantment is this maiden's habit,
Even seeing a body like fruit, why this hesitation?
Two fish are rolling — from the lips,
Two honeys are swelling,
Two deer are leaping,
Two skies are calling,
(Cheek).

songs.english_title: A paper boat upon the sea-wave

lines.english: Like a paper boat upon the sea-wave,
Let the three of us go as it goes,
A boat that sinks without support,
Like that, it is better that we sink as one,
He drew the kolam and raised the flags,
Drove the chariot and set the fire,
Watching the season, watching the hour,
He gave us life and made us suffer too,
There is no one even to hear us cry,
There is no one at all to give comfort,
There is no place for the poor to live,
In no temple is there a god,
Even mother's lap did not remain,
Even father's shadow did not protect,
Death at six, death at a hundred,
Amma, call us to you, O mother.

songs.english_title: Give one, you get nine

lines.english: Give one, you get nine,
Do you know? Do you know?
To give interest on the nine at once,
Can I do it? Can I do it?
For a woman, the flavour lies in the interest,
Put down the principal, amma, put down the principal, amma,
O fruit-flower dancing within the eye —
This is the cheek, amma, this is the cheek, amma.
A picture on the cheek, the seal of fruit-lips,
Count it and take it — I give it; marriage,
Make it — I give it,
(Now).
Give one, you get nine,
Do you know? Do you know?
To give interest on the nine at once,
Can I do it? Can I do it?
Is pleasure in bathing? In rejoicing in memory,
Is there pleasure? Is pleasure in love putting forth shoots?
Is pleasure in giving what was asked?
There is a home... why fly about for nothing?
My season too is throbbing... but,
The heart restrains it...

songs.english_title: Justice for the heart

lines.english: Justice for the heart,
A sword for the shoulder,
A radiant gem, filled full —
Wear it. Like cotton,
Are all the many sufferings;
Before your gaze — a great fire,
Without deceit, without enmity, without gambling,
So that all the people of the world may live,
The justice poet Bharathi sang,
Justice for the heart joined with truth,
Before you speak of another person's fault,

lines.source_tamil: உன் முதுகை கொஞ்சம் திரும்பி பாரு பின்னாலே
lines.english: Turn your own back a little and look behind,
The counsel of the noble,
Do not stop it merely at the lips,
Imprint it in your heart, anne,
The paths shown by the great ones of thought,
Heap them up as deeds, anne,
(One person)
Saying, 'Let us bring down caste and religions,'
Buddha and Gandhi gave their teaching,
To see God in the poor person's smile,
Arignar Anna was born here,
Let us do our duty; let us gain our rights,
Let us wipe away folly,
Let us live as human beings,
(One person)

lines.source_tamil: ஊழல் ஊழல் என்று தினம் பாடினாயே பாட்டு
lines.english: 'Corruption, corruption' — every day you sang that song,

lines.source_tamil: உன் முகத்தை நீயே ஒரு கண்ணாடியில் காட்டு
lines.english: Show your own face in a mirror yourself,
This work of casting empty blame is not for you,
It won't do, appa,

lines.source_tamil: பெரும் தூண் என்று உன் தலையில் வீழுமப்பா
lines.english: It will fall on your head like a great pillar, appa,
(One person).

songs.english_title: When the people rise, the sceptre rises

lines.english: Man: When the people rise, the sceptre rises,
When the sceptre rises, the people rise,
What heights — how beautifully, in how many ways,
Our people are dying,
They are cooking in burning fire.
'Everyone is a king of this country,' he said in the song,
Our king lives in a mud-clod house,
If thunder strikes, if rain pours,
All the kings are on the road,
Even a `sirukodindha` bird has a nest, appa,
(People rise).
We too have feeling,
In our bungalow there is a mattress,
We drink the sour-kaadi liquor,
Husband and wife do come together,
When light is thrown, when a car comes,
We move aside, move aside, and lie down....
(People rise).
All pearls are nose-mucus,
A blood-wound, they say, is a gem,
Diamonds are stars,
The rainbow itself is vaiduriyam.. how....
Kuthuk-kallu is the throne,
The garbage bin is the kingdom,
For the people who survive by dying,
There is power to destroy the world,
(People rise).

songs.english_title: Until a thousand crescents are seen

lines.english: Until a thousand crescents are seen,
Until the roar of the wave-sea falls still,
O Tamil, for you — you alone, for me,
I shall wait, I shall wait.....
Until the sun's procession stops,
Until fruit-bounty dries up in the world,
Until the Podhigai breeze sleeps,
Until Ponni `nadiyaan` flourishes,
O Tamil, for you — you,
Alone, for me..
(A thousand)
Until nature's riches endure,
Until the wealth of literature lives,
Until the beauty of youth is spent,
Until old age surges into the body,
O Tamil, for you — you,
Alone, for me,
(A thousand).

songs.english_title: A kurinji flower sways and calls

lines.english: Aa-aa... aaaa... laalalaa...
A kurinji flower sways and calls,
Come, cool breeze, to mingle and play,
In the breeze's pleasure, honey-waist mingling,
Let us live as tender shoots, floating in delight.
In the rock-candy garden, milk flowing,
Driving the plough with sugarcane as the ploughshare,
O grain-gem, wondrously grown,
O grain-gem, wondrously grown,
Let us embrace and rejoice, eye-gem!
(Kurinji).
Come write a preface for the tongue of pleasure,

lines.source_tamil: இயல் இசை கூத்தென முத்தமிழ் சுவையை தருக
lines.english: Give the taste of Muthamizh — iyal, isai, koothu,
Muthamizh, fish-eyed one — your speech is the three fruits,
You are a path to mukti,
Pour a pearl-rain.
If embraced, the two lamps will go out,
The trembling body will grow faint,
If Tamil Mother joins us,
From now on, never will I part from you,
(Kurinji).

songs.english_title: Hey, do not be lost in a dream

lines.english: Hey, do not be lost in a dream,
Am I not Kuramullai,
Think so — one day, embrace me,

lines.source_tamil: நீ வாராய் ராஜா... நீ வாராய் ராஜா...
lines.english: Come, Raja... come, Raja...
Both eyes are little, little flowers,
O man whose hands seek a woman's body,
You have taken on shyness,
You have done it to the word,
Somehow song-struck,
O season that came seeking the alli flower,
Think so — one day, embrace me,
Come, Raja, come.
To those who come, he pours out and gives,
He came as though a vallal had arrived in person,

lines.source_tamil: ரம்மை போல கண்ணு ஜின்னை போல கண்ணும்
lines.english: An eye like rammai, and an eye like jinnai too,

lines.source_tamil: ஜாடை ஒன்று காட்டி நாடி வரும் நாட்டி
lines.english: Showing one gesture — the naatti who comes seeking,
I myself came seeking you and stood here,
Think so — one day, embrace me,
Come, Raja, come.

songs.english_title: This is a fighter's journey

lines.english: This is a fighter's journey — his,
This is the prize he won by fighting,
You who laboured without rest — now,
Are you going to take rest?
You who laboured without rest — now,
Are you going to take rest?
You who crawled in your mother's lap,
Are you going to sleep beneath the ground?
Little lion who came to awaken the youth,
Sprightly golden one who shone like a young sun,
The murder-mad weapons of caste division struck you,
They took the life you lived for principle,
You who laboured without rest — now,
Are you going to take rest?

lines.source_tamil: இயேசு புத்தர் நபிகள் காந்தி காட்டும் வழியிலே
lines.english: On the path shown by Jesus, Buddha, the Prophets and Gandhi,

lines.source_tamil: பேசும் புயல் பெரியார் அண்ணா அம்பேத்கர் மொழியிலே
lines.english: In the words of the speaking storm — Periyar, Anna, Ambedkar,

lines.source_tamil: குன்றம் போல முழங்கி நடந்த குலவிளக்கு நீதியா
lines.english: O lamp of the lineage who walked roaring like a mountain — is this justice?

lines.source_tamil: உன் கொடி நிழலில் என்றும் நாங்கள் கூடுவோம் பாரடா
lines.english: Under the shade of your flag, we will gather forever — see, da.

songs.english_title: Curled-moustached Veluthambi, di

lines.english: Curled-moustached Veluthambi, di,
Hero beyond heroes, Veluthambi, di,
He will take fire from the sun and burn conspiracies,
Curled-moustached Veluthambi, di,
Hero beyond heroes, Veluthambi, di,
On the eeri-malai he will light a stove and feed the poor,

lines.source_tamil: எங்கள் குல தெய்வமாவான் அவன் தங்ககுல சிங்கமாவான்
lines.english: He will become our clan-deity; he will become the golden-clan lion,
On the earthquake-stage he will sing the song of revolution,
He will make the whole army of the wicked into powder, powder,
(Curled-moustached one, di).

lines.source_tamil: கும்மியடிப் பெண்ணே கும்மியடி குலவைப் போட்டுக் கும்மியடி
lines.english: Dance kummi, woman — dance kummi, raise the kulavai and dance kummi,

lines.source_tamil: கும்மியடிப் பெண்ணே கும்மியடி குலவைப் போட்டுக் கும்மியடி
lines.english: Dance kummi, woman — dance kummi, raise the kulavai and dance kummi.
He will give his life only for duty,
He will stand guarding dignity,
If this thambi is here, the army has no fear,
He has never forgotten this philosophy,
Placing a ban on private ownership, waging struggle for common ownership,

lines.source_tamil: தும்பியைப் போல் பறந்து வந்து துன்பங்களை தீர்த்துவைப்பான்
lines.english: Flying in like a thumbi, he will come and end suffering.

songs.english_title: Calmly, at ease, think a little and see

lines.english: “Is your vote for the Rising Sun? Our vote is for the Rising Sun itself,
Look at how the country is going and cast your vote, amma.”
Calmly, at ease, think a little and see,
Think and see about the generation that comes next,
Look at the rise and fall and place the weights,
Put barriers before the trickster and the madman,
(Calmly, at ease).
Who is the one who comes to you for your vote?
A worker — or one who cheats the town?
Who is the one standing in the election field?
Those who made sacrifice; those who committed fraud,
Do not trust the wretches who give money for votes, appa,
Do not push away the good one who gives his life for the country, appa,
We must hate the bribe-demons,
The one who ends the poor man's suffering must win... for that,
(Calmly, at ease).
Ask what price — cast your vote, amma,
Look at the price of rice and cast your vote, amma,

lines.source_tamil: இந்த படை போதுமா, இன்னும் கொஞ்சம் வேணுமா
lines.english: Is this force enough, or do you want a little more?
Who is the cruel one with no principle at all?
Who is the warrior who will not bow to cruelty?
Who is the man who lives practising corruption?
Who is the noble one who tells the town about it?

lines.source_tamil: உறவுக்கு கரம் கொடுப்பான் எங்க வீட்டு தம்பியப்பா
lines.english: For kinship he will give his hand — our house's thambi, appa,
For rights he will give his voice — the Thenpandi lion, appa,

lines.source_tamil: உதயக் கதிருதான் உதிக்குது பாரு உடன் பிறப்பே நீ ஒன்றாக சேரு
lines.english: See, the rising ray itself is rising — O udanpirappe, come together as one,
(Calmly, at ease).

songs.english_title: A tough one for guarding

lines.english: A tough one for guarding — this khaki-shirt man,
He is a fellow from Thanjavur district,
A warrior made with a fearless heart,
He will say, 'We will do what we said,'
He will say only what he actually did,
He will conduct himself so as to be trusted,
He will work for our country,
He will not take mamool,
He will not hate good people,
He will say conscience is God,
He will serve our people,
(A tough one for guarding).
When the fence itself grazes the crop — that,
He will not bear that pain,
He will not be a vengai,
Pouncing upon a white goat,
If the gang that brews illicit liquor,
Comes asking him for support,
By truth, he will flare up,
He will strike with the whip,
Hoarding and smuggling,
He will tear them into cotton-fluff, cotton-fluff,
(A tough one for guarding).

songs.english_title: Our father, endowed with a golden nature

lines.english: Our father, endowed with a golden nature,
With our overflowing tears,
We are bathing your feet,
You who made our very fingers into eyes,
And gave us the light of education!
O ocean of compassion! O Himalaya of patience!
O ocean of compassion! O Himalaya of patience!...
Making our hearts into flowers,
We string a garland and place it around the neck,
Of the summit of your fame,
Forgive us, who could not,
Protect you and keep you with us,
Our father!

songs.english_title: Can the court's balance-scale lean?

lines.english: Can the court's balance-scale lean?
Can an innocent person die without justice — die, die?
Is this what it means — sin with one, blame with another?
Is it right to call the sun's light an amavasai?
Is this a sacred land where good people live?
Or a dark forest of wicked beasts?
Is there no limit at all to what is called lawlessness?
Lord, if you exist, answer, ayya,
(Sin).
A white goat in the grip of the vengai —
Look, ayya, at the pain of being caught,
The fence itself grazes the crop —
Hear, ayya, of this cruel achievement,

lines.source_tamil: அநியாயமாக ஒரு தமிழ் மகன் சாவது நன்றோ
lines.english: Is it good that a Tamil son should die unjustly?
O Mother Tamilagam, when will you see peace?
Let the band of traitors be caught,
Let the sorrow of the pure one be ground to powder,
Raise the flag above your shoulder,
Comrade, only now comes our righteous struggle's `vaazhukku-velai`,
Our righteous struggle — `vaazhukku velai`.

songs.english_title: Like the jewel of the eye

lines.english: Lallala lallallaa,
Like the jewel of the eye,
Like the seed of a fruit,
We sons of the soil, among ourselves —
Why bitterness and hatred?
For the sons of the soil to live — in this
Soil, is there no right?
The duty is to guard the eye —
Is that such a great trouble for the eyelid?
If one walks forsaking duty,
What is guarding for? Tell me, ayya.
(Like the jewel of the eye).
To climb the sky and leap across the sea,
Courage is needed; wisdom is needed even more,
To climb the sky and leap across the sea,
Courage is needed; wisdom is needed even more,
We must see unity in difference,
The feeling of enmity must fall by the roots,
Let us give a hand for kinship; let us give voice for rights,
Say `naam` — we — and see,
The lips meet; relationships bloom,
Say `naan` — I — and see,
The lips do not join; the relationship too does not part,
(Like the jewel of the eye).

songs.english_title: Young man, young man, wake and rise

lines.english: Young man, young man, wake and rise,
I, the kalaignan, call you — wake and rise,
Come swiftly like the wind,
Come swelling like the river,
So that, studying the world, you may rise,
So that you may know yourself,
So that you may stand beside the working people,
Udanpirappe, my udanpirappe,
(Young man).
If young man and young woman rise roaring,
An age itself can be changed,
The history of caste and religious division,
Can be struck and smashed with a sledgehammer,
The Kural of Valluvar, the primordial son,
May be read, understood, and heard resounding,
(Young man).
Let the hunger for the ideal thunder like lightning,
Like a cobra that has heard the thunderclap,
Let `inba-pagai` vanish,
No indifference, beloved young man,
Bowing your head to the wise elders,
Walk in the path of the learned,
(Young man).

songs.english_title: Do not look at the rain of my two eyes

lines.english: Do not look at the rain of my two eyes,
Look instead at my heart rejoicing,
My son Ponmudi, bearing the battle-sword,
Struck down the base men and gave up his life,
Struck down the base men and gave up his life,
(My two eyes).
Saying love must not be forbidden — I joined to him,
A casket of sculpted beauty as his companion —
A maiden young-deer suited to his thought,
I waited to marry them after he returned from the field.
But he played ball with the tuskers,
Turned the steeds to cotton,
Bore the sword-points of the vile upon his chest,
Leaving his beloved to suffer as time moves on,
Leaving this old woman too floating in tears,
He finished his duty.

lines.source_tamil: களிப்பொரு பக்கம் கண்ணில் நீர் ஒரு பக்கம்
lines.english: Joy on one side, water in the eye on one side,
I praise the son who won fame on the battlefield,
Am I not the mother who bore him in the womb?
That is why I wither,
(My two eyes).

songs.english_title: Riding the chariot called the breeze

lines.source_tamil: ஆ... தென்றல் என்னும் தேர் ஏறி - தமிழ்
lines.english: Aa... riding the chariot called the breeze — O mullai flower,
Who came to the Tamil mandram,
Riding the chariot called the breeze — O mullai flower,
Who came to the Tamil mandram,
There is no beauty like you,
Transform like the rising `nyaayirene`,
Come, come as light to awaken the world!
(Breeze).
I know all the wisdom of music,
Nasika Poosani is the raga I sing,
I know all the wisdom of music,
Nasika Poosani is the raga I sing,
To utter jathi with bhava and sing —
That ability too comes with it,
I too am the one who knows, am I not?
I know the depth of many books,
(Breeze).
Thagath thom-thillanaa,
Thagath thom-thillanaa — (jathi utterance),
Thom... thom...
Your face cools like a cool moon,
Your inner self boils like burning heat,
The song of the great Madurai Tamil Sangam,
Hearing honey-sweet lips sing it,
Pluck the veena till honey flows into the ear,
Who in the world — show me.

songs.english_title: Dark machaan, this is for you

lines.english: Dark machaan, this is for you — aa...
I've kept fried fish ready — mm... mm...
Open your mouth and take it — I
Will spread the mat and lie down — mm... mm...
You leap over and hold me,
Don't shrink away and stand there; run over and lean into me,
(Hey, dark machaan).
Hey, raw-rice smile,
O fire that has caught hold of me,
I am an aandi — don't prod me and pull me.
Hey... it is the aandi who needs six-time puja,
Don't look at this `naanumuttha pora mezhugu`.
Unruly woman, beautiful demoness.
Hey... saying `adupathum ponnu`,
Mocking carelessly,
Men must reform,
Slavery must go,
After tying the thaali,
You put on an ascetic disguise,
(Dark one).
Hey... if I eat fried fish,
Saami-kutham will come upon me,
I am saivam, woman,
Don't ruin me by putting asaivam before me.
The bond of man and woman —
Isn't that itself asaivam, mama?
Don't reject the fish that comes near you.
Unruly woman,
Beautiful demoness.
O eight-legged beauty-mark,
O vehicle that Yama rides,
That is how I too, machaan,
Only mock you, ayya,
Don't you understand my condition?
Isn't your heart ours, ayya?
(Dark one).

songs.english_title: Let the affection-parrot called younger sister fondle and play

lines.english: Let the affection-parrot called younger sister fondle and play...
Let smiles bloom and dance in our overflowing hearts...
Let elder brothers stand around and joy's panpaadu dance,
Let kurinji flowers run to the young maiden's hair.
Would even the moon stand and dance before her?
Could the land-peacock be as beautiful as she?
Would even the moon stand and dance before her?
Could the land-peacock be as beautiful as she?
Aa... aa... loo... loo...

lines.source_tamil: ஆண் : தங்கை என்ற பாசக்கிளி கொஞ்சி விளையாட
lines.english: Man: Let the affection-parrot called younger sister fondle and play,
Chorus: Dance,

lines.source_tamil: ஆண் : பொங்கும் எங்கள் நெஞ்சங்களில் புன்னகைப் பூத்தாட...
lines.english: Man: Let smiles bloom and dance in our overflowing hearts...
Chorus: Dance,
Man: Let elder brothers stand around and joy's panpaadu dance,
Chorus: Dance...!
Man: Let kurinji flowers run to the young maiden's hair,
Chorus: Dance...!

lines.source_tamil: ஆண் : பிறந்தாய் ஒரு பிள்ளைக்கனி அமுதாய் பிறந்தாய்
lines.english: Man: You were born — a child-fruit, born as nectar,
You grew like a silver crescent,
You shone as a leaping young deer,
You were born to shine as a lamp in our house,

lines.source_tamil: மனோரமா: கண்ணகிதான் இங்கு வந்து தங்கையானால் பாரு
lines.english: Manorama: Look — as though Kannagi herself came here as a younger sister,
Wish the beautiful woman well on her birthday,
Woman: Both of you have become eyelids in my life,

lines.source_tamil: ஆண் : சிறந்தாய் ஒரு செம்மொழித் தமிழாய் சிறந்தாய்
lines.english: Man: You excelled — excelled as Classical Tamil,
You rose like a rich radiant ray,
You blossomed as a red jasmine flower,
You excelled — excelled as Classical Tamil,
You rose like a rich radiant ray.
You blossomed as a red jasmine flower,
Born as a younger sister in our house,
You will shine as a mother in our house,
Born as a younger sister in our house,
You will shine as a mother in our house,

lines.source_tamil: மனோரமா: உன்னை ஒரு நல்ல வீட்டு மருமகளாய் காண
lines.english: Manorama: To see you as the daughter-in-law of a good home,
This elder-brother heart yearns like a mother's heart,
Woman: Amma, my eyes are becoming ponds...

songs.english_title: Every wave dances

lines.english: Every wave dances; the Tamil people's,
Every art sings its own culture.
Running and playing in the forests,
The deer-kind, rich in dignity,
Singing music,
Paired cuckoo,
With rhythm,
Set bhava,
Forest peacock,
Bird-kind too,
Silk flag,
Victory parasol.
Circle and whirl,
Sacred victory,
Pearl-Tamil,
Learned radiance,
Having received — clan,
Chola land's,
Fame to sing,
Let us bow in worship.

songs.english_title: Is what rises from the veena a flute-song?

lines.english: Aahaa...
Is what rises from the veena a venu-song?
Is it Thiruvathirai's Todi raga?
Is it Thiruvenkadu's magudi sound?
Two lives join because they harmonize,
Once joined, are not the two a single life?
Man: Budding in the morning, flowering in the evening,
I too melted from the disease of love,
Woman: Budding in the morning, flowering in the evening,
I too melted from the disease of love,
Man: You became a painting — are you not the Kodumudi kokilam?
You plundered,
My very heart; give it back,
Just as you took it,
Woman: Once honey and milk are mixed,
Can their taste be separated out?
Man: You as sweet honey,
And I as throbbing `aanpaal`,
After marriage, we may become honey and milk,
Woman: A thousand nights are enough,
A paayiram song is enough now,
Man: Like water upon red earth, our loving hearts,
We have mingled.
